actions: sort first column ascending/descending and clear

boundaries: Inputs are real CUA/native actions, retained separately with UTC times. No generated redraw loop is added to the native sample.
Window visibility pauses the denominator. Dimensions and scale remain fixed.
GPUI framework work/draw and browser rAF are separately reported; rAF alone is not content-change or GPU time.
Process CPU is summed cumulative CPU-time deltas for explicit PIDs; RSS is resident host memory, not complete GPU/private memory.
No integrated conversation, streaming/history/tree or production performance claim.
